function.name: search_connected_services
function.description: Search services that are connected to the user's IFTTT account by keywords.

keywords.description: Keywords to search for connected services, e.g., 'Twitter', 'Gmail', 'Weather'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

function.name: search_triggers
function.description: Search for available triggers by keywords for a specific connected service. The triggers are events that happen on the service, such as a new tweet, a new email, or a new weather forecast.

service_name.description: The service to search for triggers, e.g., 'Twitter', 'Gmail', 'Weather'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

keywords.description: Keywords to search for triggers, e.g., 'new tweet', 'received email', 'temperature'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: search_actions
function.description: Search for available actions by keywords for a specific connected service. The actions are something that can be done on the service, e.g., post a tweet, send an email, turn on a light.

service_name.description: The service to search for actions, e.g., 'Twitter', 'Gmail', 'Hue'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

keywords.description: Keywords to search for actions, e.g., 'post tweet', 'send email', 'turn on light'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: create_applet
function.description: Create a new applet with a specified trigger and action. Once the trigger is activated, the action will be performed.

trigger_service_name.description: The service of the trigger for the applet, e.g., 'Twitter'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

trigger_name.description: The specific trigger from the service for the applet, e.g., 'new tweet from user'. Must be an existing trigger returned by SearchTriggers for the specified service.

trigger_parameters.description: The parameters for the trigger. Must be a valid object matching the description returned by SearchTriggers for the specified trigger.

action_service_name.description: The service of the action for the applet, e.g., 'Gmail'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

action_name.description: The specific action from the service to perform when the trigger is activated, e.g., 'send an email'. Must be an existing action returned by SearchActions for the specified service.

action_parameters.description: The parameters for the action. Must be a valid object matching the description returned by SearchActions for the specified action.

function.name: search_applets
function.description: Search for applets matching the specified criteria.

trigger_keywords.description: The keywords to search for in the trigger name. If not specified, all triggers will be considered.

action_keywords.description: The keywords to search for in the action name. If not specified, all actions will be considered.

max_results.description: The maximum number of applets to return.

function.name: update_applet
function.description: Update an existing applet with new trigger and action settings.

applet_id.description: The unique identifier of the applet to update.

trigger_service_name.description: The new service of the trigger for the applet, e.g., 'Twitter'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

trigger_name.description: The new trigger from the service for the applet, e.g., 'new tweet from user'. Must be an existing trigger returned by SearchTriggers for the specified service.

trigger_parameters.description: The new parameters for the trigger. Must be a valid object matching the description returned by SearchTriggers for the specified trigger.

action_service_name.description: The new service of the action for the applet, e.g., 'Gmail'. Must be an existing connected service returned by ListConnectedServices.

action_name.description: The new action from the service to perform when the trigger is activated, e.g., 'send an email'. Must be an existing action returned by SearchActions for the specified service.

action_parameters.description: The new parameters for the action. Must be a valid object matching the description returned by SearchActions for the specified action.

applet_ids.description: The list of unique identifiers of the applets to delete.
